speaker: Measurement
text:
RESULTS: Temperature 37.4°C (99.3°F), Heart Rate 117 bpm, Oxygen Saturation 99% on room air. Urinalysis: Appearance Clear, WBC 0-5 /HPF, RBC 0-2 /HPF, Nitrites Negative, Leukocyte Esterase Negative. Scrotal Ultrasound: Decreased blood flow to the right testicle, suggestive of testicular torsion.

**Clinical Note:** The patient is experiencing a medical emergency consistent with testicular torsion (elevated testicle, horizontal lie, absent cremasteric reflex, pain on elevation, decreased blood flow on ultrasound). This requires immediate surgical intervention to save the testicle. The abdominal pain is likely referred pain from the torsion. Please proceed immediately to the Emergency Department for urological consultation.
